title: Eve of the Grand Competition
next_chapter_hook: In the golden light of the Tianji Record, a blurry image emerged—a crimson formation slowly taking shape in the center of the Competition Square, and at its core, a familiar figure was waving to him. Was it Ling Yuan, or someone else?

text.content:
The sky was still pale white, morning mist shrouding the Tianqing Sect Martial Arena like a thin veil. The blue stone steps were covered with a thin layer of dew, slightly slippery underfoot. Chen Ji walked upward step by step with his head bowed, the ice-cold, sharp warning voice of Mo Xiansheng from last night still echoing in his mind.

"At the Sect Competition, someone has set a lethal trap, waiting for him to step into the deadly ground."

He didn't look back, because there was no retreat behind him. The Tianji Record Fragment on his chest burned slightly, like urging, or warning. For twenty-seven years, he had never sensed so clearly as today that the iron chain of fate was tightening.

The plaza before the Martial Arena was already bustling with voices. Dozens of disciples lined up in several rows, waiting for the registration disciples to verify their identities. A banner hung high, bearing six gilded characters "Tianqing Sect Sect Competition," gleaming in the morning light.

Chen Ji silently stood at the end of the line, like a drop of water merging into a river, completely unremarkable. Yet the discussions around him buzzed like a swarm of bees entering his ears—"I heard the rewards for this year's competition have doubled"—"Xuanwu Sect's Han Lie has already declared he will sweep our sect"—"Does the废物 Chen Ji also come to make a fool of himself? What a joke."

dialogue.content:
"Oh, isn't this our 'genius' Chen Ji?

A hoarse yet robust voice rang out from the front of the crowd. Everyone turned to look, as an elderly man in a dark cyan robe stepped out from the registration area. His hair and beard were all white, but his eyes blazed like torches, and his aura was deep and profound like the sea.

Ling Yuan, the former Sect Master of Tianqing Sect, a legendary figure said to have reached the pinnacle of Divine Transformation Stage.

He walked toward Chen Ji with a smile, each step striking the hearts of everyone present. "What, you've also come to register for the competition? I remember you've been in the sect for seven years and haven't even broken through Qi Refining Stage Three, right?"

text.content:
Silence fell instantly around them, so quiet that a needle dropping could be heard. Everyone was watching this scene. Some showed sympathy, some rejoiced at his misfortune, and more simply watched as spectators.

Ling Yuan's words were like a dull blade—not piercing directly into flesh, but slowly, inch by inch, cutting away dignity. His face always wore a kind, benevolent smile, as if just caring for a junior.

"I have always sympathized with the young," Ling Yuan stroked his long beard. "How about this—if you are willing to admit before all sect disciples that you entered the sect through connections, and swear never to participate in any combat... I will grant you a Foundation Building Elixir to help you break through your bottleneck. How about that?"

dialogue.content:
"Ha ha, what a wonderful proposal from Elder Ling!

A rough, hearty laughter exploded from the crowd, and a muscular youth strode out like an iron tower—it was Han Lie, the number one genius of Xuanwu Sect. He crossed his fists over his chest, looking down at Chen Ji from above, his contempt practically overflowing.

"Honestly, Chen Ji, right? Last time in the secret realm, you got lucky and took advantage of me. Today at the competition, I won't give you that chance." He spat. "If you know what's good for you, get lost and go back to farming. Don't丢人现眼 here!"

text.content:
Han Lie's mockery was like a loud slap on Chen Ji's face. Surrounding laughter erupted, with some joining in: "废物 and farming—a perfect match!"—"Go back and hold babies already!"—"If I were him, I'd have found a block of tofu to bang my head against!"

Chen Ji stood quietly in place, neither defending nor retorting. His gaze was calm to the point of terrifying, like a stagnant pool, showing no ripples.

But if someone were perceptive enough, they would notice his hands hanging at his sides were trembling slightly—not from fear, but from rage suppressed to the extreme.

Twenty-seven years of being called废物, seven years of humiliation and trampling—this moment all transformed into a burning fire in his chest, surging and galloping through his five viscera and six bowels.

Ling Yuan narrowed his eyes, examining Chen Ji's expression. What slightly surprised him was that this kid hadn't cried or run away; instead, he appeared unruffled.

"What, no words?" Ling Yuan stepped forward, his spiritual pressure pressing down like a mountain. "Or are you truly so delusional as to think you have what it takes to turn the tables at the competition?"

Chen Ji felt an invisible force pressing on his shoulders, his knees slightly trembling. But his spine remained straight as ever.

"This disciple..." he slowly spoke, his voice hoarse but steady, "this disciple merely wishes to participate in the competition, nothing more."

Ling Yuan's brow furrowed almost imperceptibly. This answer was too bland, too bland to the point of unease. How could someone so publicly humiliated remain so calm?

"Nothing more?" Han Lie coldly snorted, pushing forward. "If you didn't want to show off at the competition, why bother queuing up so early in the morning? I think you've been playing the coward until today, wanting to turn things around through combat!"

He poked toward Chen Ji's chest, each poke accompanied by words: "Unfortunately—people like you—will never—make it!"

Chen Ji was poked back two steps, yet still did not retaliate. The surrounding laughter grew louder, and even some disciples who had felt sympathy began to waver—this Chen Ji truly was pathetically spineless.

choice.prompt: Facing the combined humiliation from Ling Yuan and Han Lie, Chen Ji chose to endure. But now, he needed to make a choice among several response options—should he completely play the humble victim to avoid trouble, or secretly keep a mental record of this debt?

choices.description: Bow your head and play dumb, let them mock you freely, and secretly prepare while biding your time.
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan temporarily lowers his guard
choices.risk_hint: The watching disciples may despise you even more

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, slowly bent into a bow, his voice low as a mosquito's buzz: "This disciple... knows his mistake. Since Elder Ling forbids it, this disciple will withdraw from registration..."

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan narrowed his eyes to examine him, then after a moment coldly laughed: "Smart of you."

choices.description: Use the废物 persona to confuse enemies, actually记下 each and every debt, and wait for the right moment to retaliate.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Ling Yuan's contemptuous buff, can trigger counterattack later

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his head, hands slightly trembling, voice quivering: "This disciple... merely wanted to prove himself... forget it, this disciple won't register..."

dialogue.content: Han Lie burst out laughing: "Want to prove yourself? With you? Next lifetime!"

choices.description: Reply with neither servility nor arrogance, neither rude nor lacking in hidden edge.
choices.visible_reward: Reveal true edge, drawing attention from some
choices.risk_hint: May provoke Ling Yuan and Han Lie

text.content: Chen Ji slowly raised his head, a barely perceptible curve forming at the corner of his lips: "This disciple is indeed trash, but even trash has the right to sign up for the Sect Tournament. Does the rules state that Qi Refining Third Stage cannot register?"

dialogue.content: Cold light flashed in Ling Yuan's eyes, yet his smile deepened: "Bold. Since it's come to this, let this old man see... what waves can this dead fish make?"

text.content:
In the end, Chen Ji chose to register. He walked past Ling Yuan with his head bowed, his steps unsteady, as if he might fall at any moment. In truth, only he knew that every muscle was tense like a drawn bow.

The Tianji Record Fragment pulsed violently against his chest, a desire unlike any he'd felt before—urging him to use that power.

But Mo Xiansheng had said that every use would consume precious Heavenly Fate. And he now had less than thirty points remaining.

"To use or not to use?" he asked himself.

"Don't use, and you might die at the Sect Tournament. Use it, and you might die even sooner."

dialogue.content:
Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed like a specter in his mind, tinged with urgency: "Boy, are you certain you want to use the Tianji Record here? Ling Yuan's perception is extraordinary—if he detects anything unusual..."

Chen Ji gave no answer. He found a secluded corner, pressed his back against the wall, and slowly closed his eyes.

The Tianji Record Fragment rose from his chest, golden light blazing. Mo Xiansheng's figure flickered in the radiance, his expression grave as never before.

"Have you decided?"

text.content:
Chen Ji nodded slowly, his voice calm yet resolute: "Ling Yuan won't let me off. Instead of waiting for him to strike first, I'd rather see through his hidden cards."

His fingers gently brushed across the Tianji Record Fragment, and the dense ancient runes on the paper began to glow faintly. Mo Xiansheng sighed and said no more.

"Within three hours, all causes and effects lie within my sight."

The golden light abruptly contracted, transforming into an invisible divine consciousness that shot into Chen Ji's Brow Center. In that moment, he felt his consciousness torn from his body, falling into a chaotic void.

Heavenly Fate, -5.

choice.prompt: The Tianji Record activates, and Chen Ji is about to glimpse three hours into the future. He can choose what information to focus on—concerning Ling Yuan's lethal trap, or Han Lie's movements?

choices.description: Fully investigate the details of the lethal trap Ling Yuan has arranged at the Sect Tournament.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain detailed intelligence on the trap: formation location, triggering conditions, mastermind behind the scenes
choices.risk_hint: Consumes more Heavenly Fate, and may expose one's location

text.content: Chen Ji poured all his divine consciousness into the Tianji Record. The scene in the void gradually sharpened—he saw at the center of the Competition Square a hidden crimson formation being set up. The formation patterns were complex and eerie, emanating a chilling scent of blood.

choices.description: Simultaneously observe Ling Yuan and Han Lie's movements, leaving no threat unnoticed.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain trajectories of both parties' actions, but details are relatively vague
choices.risk_hint: Vision is divided, may miss crucial information

text.content: Chen Ji dispersed his divine consciousness. The scene in the void became fragmented. He saw Ling Yuan conversing with a black-robed figure in a secret chamber, and also saw Han Lie training frantically at the Martial Arena.

Scenes flowed before Chen Ji's eyes like water. He saw—

In the third round of the Sect Tournament, he was locked in fierce combat with an Inner Disciple. Sword lights gleamed, killing intent surged. Everything seemed normal, until the moment he stepped into the center of the arena.

The ground suddenly blazed with crimson light, and a blood-colored restraining formation rose from beneath his feet! Formation patterns coiled around his ankles like living creatures, a诡异的 suction force began draining his vital energy.

And at the core of the formation, a figure stood watching him with a smile—Ling Yuan.

"As expected." Chen Ji coldly smirked in his heart, "Old fox, you've finally shown your true colors."

The vision continued to flow. He saw himself trapped within the formation, unable to move. Disciples around screamed and scattered, only Ling Yuan stood with hands clasped behind his back, declaring loudly: "Chen Ji has cultivated demonic arts, fallen into demonic madness—this old man had no choice but to suppress him—"

What a magnificent and dignified excuse!

Chen Ji stared fixedly at that kind-looking old face, his killing intent blazing like fire. This was the scheme of an old monster at the peak of Nascent Soul Transformation? Using the Sect Tournament as an opportunity, before all the sect's disciples, to kill him in the name of "suppressing demonic cultivators"—not even his reputation would be spared.

But what chilled his heart even more—this formation was definitely not something Ling Yuan alone could set up. There must be an even more formidable existence behind him.

dialogue.content:
Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his ear, carrying a hint of praise: "Not bad. That you can see these things means the Tianji Record has acknowledged you as its master. However... lad, have you noticed one detail?"

Chen Ji's brow furrowed. His divine sense swept over the scene again—formation, bloodlight, Ling Yuan's smile... wait!

At the edge of the formation, he saw a blurry figure. That figure lurked within the crowd, features indistinguishable, yet emanating a familiar chill of malevolence.

"That is... someone from the Holy Sect?" Chen Ji blurted out.

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment before speaking slowly: "The Tianji Record only displays cause and effect, never the complete picture. This figure's appearance means there's some kind of deal between Ling Yuan and the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path."

Chen Ji suddenly thought of Ye Qing—that demonic path saintess. She had mentioned the Holy Sect was always hunting for Tianji Record holders. And now, Ling Yuan was colluding with them?

"No wonder Mr. Mo warned me last night." Chen Ji understood in his heart, "This lethal trap was aimed at me from the start."

The Tianji Record's vision began to blur, and Chen Ji felt himself being forcibly pulled back to reality. But in that final moment, he caught another crucial piece of information—a tiny crack in the formation's northeastern corner.

The instant his consciousness returned to his body, Chen Ji's eyes snapped open. Cold sweat had soaked through his back, and the Tianji Record fragment over his chest had dimmed to near darkness, as if exhausted.

He looked down at his trembling hands. The trembling wasn't from fear, but from rage—the fury of being trampled like an ant.

"Ling Yuan..." he murmured that name softly, a cold smile curving his lips, "Did you think I was a lamb waiting to be slaughtered?"

"Unfortunately, you overlooked one thing—" He rose to his feet, his gaze sharp as a blade, "I was never any kind of废物."

In the distance, the banners at the registration area fluttered violently in the wind. The horn for the Sect Tournament was about to sound.

dialogue.content:
Mo Xiansheng's form appeared above the fragment, gazing at Chen Ji with a complicated expression: "You saw through the flaw in the lethal trap, but don't celebrate too soon. The Tianji Record only shows cause and effect within three hours—what happens after that holds endless variables."

He paused, speaking with deep meaning: "Remember, those who peer into Heavenly Secrets are themselves being watched by Heavenly Secrets. Whether that mysterious figure saw your窥视, even this old man cannot guarantee."

Chen Ji's heart tightened, though his expression remained calm: "Thank you for the warning, sir. However—"

"Since we've already entered the game, there's only one path left to walk."

text.content:
Tianqing Sect Martial Arena, Sect Competition registration.

Ling Yuan stood atop the high platform, overlooking the bustling disciples below. His gaze swept through the crowd and finally fixed on the direction where Chen Ji had departed, a sinister glint flickering in his eyes.

"Master, that废物 actually registered." A voice came from behind, belonging to Ling Yuan's personal disciple.

Ling Yuan sneered: "So he registered? What of it? The 'gift' I've prepared for him won't be diminished simply because he's a废物." He caressed the jade slip in his hand, the key to controlling the formation, "Three days from now, at the competition... will be Chen Ji's burial day."

Meanwhile, in a secret chamber at the Xuanwu Sect residence, Han Lie was grinding his teeth at a communication jade mirror:

"废物 Chen Ji... last time in the secret realm you escaped. This time, let's see how you dodge!"

And in a hidden cave on the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, the cloaked figure Chen Ji had witnessed in his vision sat cross-legged, surrounded by eerie black mist.

"The Tianji Record's wielder... has finally appeared." His voice was hoarse like dry leaves scraping together, "Interesting... this time's piece seems far more entertaining than those before."

choice.prompt: With the competition imminent, Chen Ji needed to decide his next move. He could seek allies' help, prepare alone, or take preemptive action to disrupt the enemy's plans.

choices.description: Contact Ye Qing, using her demonic path mist to conceal the Tianji Record's aura while gaining intelligence on the Holy Sect's internal affairs.
choices.visible_reward: Gain demonic path mist protection, reducing the risk of discovery; may learn the details of the deal between the Holy Sect and Ling Yuan
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may not arrive in time

text.content: Chen Ji quietly slipped away from the crowd and found a secluded spot, taking out a black communication talisman. It was a lifesaver Ye Qing had left him, "If you face a certain death situation, crush this talisman."

dialogue.content: A cold, clear voice came through the talisman from Ye Qing: "Chen Ji? You're actually contacting me... what's happened?"

choices.description: Use the remaining time to study the formation's weaknesses while secretly preparing contingencies.
choices.visible_cost: Time is tight, preparations may be insufficient
choices.visible_reward: Maintain secrecy, grasp the initiative; may discover more weaknesses
choices.risk_hint: Fight alone, bear the risks yourself

text.content: Chen Ji returned to his decrepit shack, taking out the Tianji Record fragment from his chest. The characters on the paper shimmered faintly under the moonlight, as if recounting some ancient secret.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's figure materialized: "You want to study that weakness? That's one approach. But I advise you, don't place all your hopes on the Tianji Record—it's merely a tool, not omnipotent."

choices.description: Before the competition begins, proactively expose part of Ling Yuan's plot, using others as a blade.
choices.visible_cost: Revealing your hand too early poses enormous risks
choices.visible_reward: May use Su Qingyao or others to disrupt Ling Yuan's plans
choices.risk_hint: May backfire and bring trouble upon yourself

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered, and a bold plan took shape in his mind. What he needed to do wasn't a direct confrontation, but rather—to borrow a knife to kill.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao, the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, happened to pass by this place. Seeing Chen Ji standing alone in the corner, a hint of confusion flickered in her eyes. This waste... what is he up to again?

text.content:
Night deepened, and the Tianqing Sect lay shrouded in silence.

Chen Ji lay on the bed, his mind constantly replaying the visions from the Tianji Record—the crimson formation, Ling Yuan's smile, and that mysterious black-robed figure.

He knew that from the moment he signed up, he had stepped into an elaborately designed deadly ground. Ling Yuan would not give him any chance of survival, and the shadows of the Holy Sect lurked in the darkness, stirring with intent.

But he was not entirely unprepared.

"The Sect Competition in three days..." he murmured to himself, his eyes flickering with a cold gleam. "Ling Yuan, do you think you've got me cornered?"

Outside the window, a cold crescent moon hung high. Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, his breathing gradually steadying.

Conserving energy and building strength, waiting only for that moment to arrive.

On the eve of the competition, the winds were about to rise. And he, Chen Ji, would become the greatest variable in this chess game.

Within the golden light of the Tianji Record, blurred visions emerged—the crimson formation slowly taking shape at the center of the Competition Square, and at the core of the formation, a familiar figure was beckoning to him. Was it Ling Yuan, or someone else entirely?
